The use of `_gitversion`, `_ghurl`, and similar variables is for clarity and reuse, not obfuscation.

Since `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` only sources the PKGBUILD and downloads the sources (without extracting or running anything), and because no malicious code execution occurs during sourcing, this step is safe.
</details>
